strengths: No fake statistics, dates, or survey percentages
Platform boarding marks, number tickets, staff interventions, and alight-before-board are observable operator/shop practice
Disaster-orderliness is not asserted as a national law
Punctuality link is already framed as one passenger-side tool, not the whole timetable
verified: Many urban Japanese railway/metro platforms mark boarding positions so doors meet pre-formed lines (not every rural or minor-station platform)
School lunch lines, assemblies, and evacuation drills commonly socialize lining up (implementation varies by school)
Number-ticket systems at bakeries, clinics, and municipal counters are widespread
Letting passengers off before boarding is standard station practice and signage
Theme parks and airports use switchbacks, belt marks, and staff-directed files
Cutting and messy sales/New Year crowding occur and are socially noticed
questionable: ‘Train punctuality depends on dwell time’ is directionally true in operations talk but stated a bit tightly; dwell also depends on crowding, luggage, door width, and incidents
School lining as a distinctive trainer of adult Japanese queuing—many countries line up at school; Japan-specific weight is interpretive
Classroom cleaning as ‘the same socialization’ as queuing is an editorial grouping, not a documented cause
International disaster coverage of orderly lines is real as a media pattern; treating any specific disaster as proof should stay hedged (the article does)
needs_source: Any future exact dwell-time seconds, on-time percentages, or survey of ‘patience’
Named disaster case studies if the myth paragraph is ever made specific

issues.location: How Japanese People Experience Waiting — punctuality/dwell
issues.problem: Dwell time is a real operations factor, but the sentence can be read as ‘queues keep the timetable alive’ without the other causes.
issues.suggestion: Keep ‘one of the passenger-side tools’; soften ‘depends on’ to ‘is affected by’ or ‘short boarding chaos eats dwell time.’ Do not invent numbers.

issues.problem: Causal chain from childhood drills to adult platform files is plausible socialization, not a sourced finding. Cleaning-classroom link is extra causal stretch.
issues.suggestion: Keep as interpretation/habit; do not upgrade to history or psychology fact.
